doc: F8: the skin chain qualifies skin by face-region mesh density, not a face count (card tsk_0f87f7ced81c2849). The shipped child input is a 4.00x decimation of its own full body, so the falsifier fires: the input keeps refusing, routed to the denser mesh.
property: face-region mesh density, faces/m2 of 3D face area over a stature-scaled window (derive.py face_region_density: y in [ytop-0.30s, ytop-0.02s], |x-cx| < 0.09s, z > median z, s = stature/1.7, faces with >=2 verts inside). UV texel density was measured and rejected: the decimated meshes share the full UV atlas (LOD 18.8M vs Aisha 15.1M texels/m2), so it cannot separate.
threshold_source: Between the known-good (Aisha 589953, body2 618415) and the known-bad (runtime LOD 36597), with the decimated child input (211799) on the refuse side per the falsifier. Nearest pass 1.47x above (Aisha), nearest refuse 0.53x below (child input).

falsifier.detail: mpfb_peds_patient_child_body ships at 41950 verts / 79240 faces in lid-conform-child/confirm/peds_asthma_parent_anxiety_v1-lidconform.glb and at 11075 verts / 19802 faces in the face-station input, with identical bboxes (X +-0.386, Y [0, 1.25], Z [-0.068, 0.251]). The input is a decimation of the full-topology child body, not a native mesh: kept refusing, routed to the denser mesh.
